metas.name: Alaska - Trekker - Black Beanie Trekker
metas.note: The trekker’s black and white bandana can only be seen in Nome.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: Alaska - Trekker - Shrekker
metas.note: Nome, Unalakleet and Galena are three isolated Alaskan towns which are covered only by trekker. The trekker’s lime green hat can be seen.
metas.footer: Check out https://www.plonkit.net/ for more clues.

metas.name: American Samoa - Trekker - Aunu Ferry
metas.note: The only ferry Trekker of American Samoa. If you're on a boat between two islands in AS, you're here.

metas.name: American Samoa - Trekker - Ofu Beach
metas.note: Ofu Beach is easy to recognize, with the coast to the Southeast and three distinct peaks in the Northeast.

metas.name: Argentina - Trekker - Horse Trekker
metas.note: This horse trekker can be found in southwestern San Juan.

metas.name: Brazil - Trekker - Amazonian Trekker
metas.note: This Amazonian trekker combines boat and walking coverage on and near the Madeira and Aripuana rivers, south of the 319. They are seen travelling through dense rainforest and small villages.

metas.name: Brazil - Trekker - Lençóis Maranhenses National Park
metas.note: The beautiful National Park of Northeast Maranhão, known for its sand dunes with pools of water, has walking trekker and vehicle coverage. The truck is white with a black bed. The landscape can vary from beach to sandy wetland.

metas.name: Brazil - Trekker - Noronha Boat Trekker
metas.note: There is boat coverage around the island of Ilha de Fernando de Noronha.

metas.name: Chile - Trekker - ACA
metas.note: ACA can be recognized by the many radio telescopes in a barren, snowy environment.

metas.name: Chile - Trekker - ALMA-OSF
metas.note: ALMA OSF can be recognized by the large radio telescopes and rural facilities.

metas.name: Chile - Trekker - Horse Trekker
metas.note:
This horse trekker can be seen to the northwest of San Filipe.

NOTE: A similar trekker can be found on the other side of the border in Argentina.

metas.name: Chile - Trekker - Torres Del Paine
metas.note: The Torres del Paine area can be recognized by the sharp peaked mountains, and the trekker walking on a glacier along with other people in orange helmets.

metas.name: Colombia - Trekker - Trebal Resort Trekker
metas.note: This trekker can be recognized by the unique pavement and houses.
metas.footer: Source: A Learnable Colombia by Timo

metas.name: France - Trekker - Boat Trekker
metas.note: Several cities along the Cote d'Azur host boat trekkers in their harbours.

metas.name: Malta - Trekker - Ship Trekker
metas.note: This trekker on a ship that is painted white and blue can be seen between the main island and Gozo Island.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/malta for more clues.

metas.name: Peru - Trekker - Train Trekker
metas.note: A train track covered by a trekker is located between Aguas Calientes and Cusco.

metas.name: United States - Donner Park Trekker
metas.note: You can see this car all over the Donner Park in Columbus, IN.
metas.footer: Source: A Unique USA by mistystar

metas.name: United States - Trekker - Disney World Trekker
metas.note: GeoGuessr’s official maps have a bias for trekkers. Thus, if you’re playing the official US map or official state streaks, you should be aware of there being a lot of trekker coverage in Disney World in Orlando.
metas.footer: Source: A Unique USA by mistystar

metas.name: United States - Trekker - Dry Tortugas
metas.note:
The main island of Dry Tortugas National Park, west of Key West, can be identified by the hexagonal brick structure and the surrounding moat.

The Loggerhead Lighthouse, situated on the Loggerhead Key, has a brown top-half and a white bottom. The path on which the trekker walks on is also made of bright concrete, and many palm trees can be seen around the lighthouse.
